name: Aquatic (Magic Armor or Shield Quality)
body:
Aura faint transmutation; CL 5th; Price +6,000 gp; Weight -5lbs.

DESCRIPTION

These sets of armor were made to assist those who may need to spend significant time underwater or at sea. While wearing a set of aquatic armor you are under the constant effect of a water breathing spell and gain a swim speed of 20 ft, unless you already possess a better swim speed.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Magic Arms and Armor, water breathing
